title: MortersPeres-2010-BrownianMotion
universal_lens: Brownian motion as a stochastic process with continuous sample paths, characterized by independent increments and Gaussian distribution, forming a cornerstone in probability theory and mathematical physics. Harmonic analysis and probabilistic recurrence criteria unify Brownian motion path behavior through Paley-Zygmund and Kochen-Stone lemmas.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference framework for probabilistic modeling of Brownian motion paths using finite-dimensional distributions and conditional expectations, enabling predictive state estimation under uncertainty. Bayesian inference on Brownian path recurrence uses Paley-Zygmund bounds for posterior probability thresholds in stochastic process modeling.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning engine for dynamic state transitions in Brownian motion, leveraging Markov properties and sample path regularity to simulate real-time stochastic evolution and decision-making. State transitions in Brownian motion are governed by Borel-Cantelli-type logic, enabling predictive path sampling via Kochen-Stone conditional dependencies.
